Keywords: facebook instagram conversion purchase lead gen roas e-commerce sales
Goal: Drive purchases, leads, or sign-ups with Meta's conversion optimization algorithm
Creative Tips: Video or carousel performs best for e-commerce. Use UGC-style video (authentic, not overly produced). Include price and offer in first 3 seconds. Test 3-5 creative variants per ad set.
Targeting: Broad targeting now outperforms narrow interest targeting (let Meta algorithm optimize). Lookalike audiences (1-5%) from email list or purchasers. Retargeting: website visitors + cart abandoners.
Budget: Start at $20-50/day per ad set. Scale winners 20% every 3 days (not more). Budget at campaign level using CBO (Campaign Budget Optimization).
Metrics: ROAS (aim 2.5-4x for e-commerce), CPA, CTR (aim 1-3% for conversion ads), frequency (alarm at 3+)
Best For: E-commerce, lead gen, app installs, event registrations, B2C services

Keywords: retargeting remarketing website visitors cart abandonment dynamic product ads warm audience
Goal: Re-engage people who've shown intent but haven't converted
Creative Tips: Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) automatically show the exact product they viewed. Use testimonial/social proof creative for mid-funnel retargeting. Create urgency with time-limited offers.
Targeting: Custom Audiences: website visitors (30-day), cart abandoners, video viewers (75%+), email list. Exclude recent purchasers.
Budget: Lower CPA than cold audiences. Start with $10-30/day per retargeting segment.
Metrics: Conversion rate vs cold traffic, ROAS, return rate (are you re-acquiring past buyers?)
Best For: E-commerce (abandoned cart), SaaS (trial-to-paid), course creators (webinar attendees)

Keywords: brand awareness reach impressions video views new audience discovery CPM
Goal: Introduce brand to new audiences at lowest cost per impression
Creative Tips: Video works best. Keep videos under 15 seconds for awareness. No hard CTA — soft brand exposure. Focus on storytelling and emotion over conversion.
Targeting: Broad audience targeting. Interest-based for specific demographics. Location-based for local businesses.
Budget: Optimize for CPM (cost per 1000 impressions) or video views. Lower budget — $10-20/day for testing.
Metrics: CPM (aim $5-15 for Facebook), video view rate, brand search lift, reach
Best For: Launching a new brand, entering a new market, building top-of-funnel before conversion campaigns

Keywords: lead gen form facebook lead ads fill email phone instant form no website
Goal: Capture leads without a landing page — users stay on Facebook/Instagram
Creative Tips: Meta Lead Ads (form opens within the app). Pre-fill name and email from profile data. Ask minimal questions (name + email + one qualifier max). Follow up within 5 minutes via email/SMS.
Targeting: Lookalike audiences from existing customer list. Interest targeting for relevant demographic. Exclude existing customers.
Budget: Start at $20-40/day. Cost per lead varies wildly by industry ($5-$150). Test different form questions to optimize CPL.
Metrics: Cost per lead (CPL), lead quality rate (what % convert to customers), form completion rate
Best For: Local services, B2B lead gen, real estate, insurance, education, events

Keywords: google search ads ppc keyword intent purchase buy best near me comparison
Goal: Capture high-intent searchers actively looking for your solution
Creative Tips: Write 3+ headlines and 2+ descriptions per ad (responsive search ads). Include keyword in headline 1. Use ad extensions (site links, callouts, structured snippets). Match landing page to ad copy.
Targeting: Exact match + phrase match for control. Broad match when using Smart Bidding. Negative keywords are critical (add weekly). Target buyer-intent keywords ('buy', 'pricing', 'best', '[Brand] alternative').
Budget: Start at $30-100/day. Use Target CPA or Maximize Conversions bidding after 30+ conversions. Budget for 100+ clicks to test ad group.
Metrics: Quality Score (aim 7+), CTR (aim 3-8%), conversion rate, CPA, impression share
Best For: E-commerce, local services, SaaS, lead gen, B2B — any high-intent buyer search

Keywords: google performance max pmax ai all placements automated smart campaign
Goal: Run across all Google inventory (Search, Display, YouTube, Gmail, Maps) with one campaign
Creative Tips: Upload 15-20 image assets, 5 videos (or Google auto-creates from images), 5 headlines, 5 descriptions. High-quality creative is critical. Feed Google your best audience signals.
Targeting: Audience signals: upload customer list, website visitors, converters. Add interest/demographic signals. PMax learns — give it 4-6 weeks before major changes.
Budget: Minimum $50-100/day recommended. Budget impacts how fast Google learns. Allow 4-6 week learning period before optimization.
Metrics: Conv. rate, ROAS, CPA vs historical campaigns, conversion value
Best For: E-commerce (strong product feed needed), lead gen, app installs. Best when you have conversion history.

Keywords: linkedin sponsored content b2b professional lead gen thought leadership
Goal: Reach B2B decision-makers with the most precise professional targeting
Creative Tips: Single image, video, or carousel for different goals. Lead Gen Forms (pre-filled from LinkedIn profile) have 3x higher conversion than landing pages. Document Ads (PDF carousels) have high engagement.

Keywords: tiktok ads in feed native video UGC creative performance e-commerce conversion
Goal: Reach TikTok's engaged audience with native-feeling video ads
Creative Tips: Native-style UGC (user-generated content) dramatically outperforms produced corporate video. Hook in first 2-3 seconds is critical. Use trending sounds. Show product in use, not just product. Caption adds context.
Targeting: Interest targeting + behavior-based + Custom Audiences (email list, website visitors). 'Broad Plus' similar to Meta's broad strategy — let algorithm optimize.
Budget: Start at $50/day minimum for in-feed (TikTok Ads Manager minimum $50 campaign budget). Spark Ads (boosting organic posts) can start at $20/day.
Metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR (aim 1-2%), video completion rate (signal of good creative)
Best For: D2C e-commerce, apps, younger demographics (18-34), consumer brands, lifestyle products

Keywords: youtube video ads pre-roll skippable non-skippable in-stream CPV awareness
Goal: Reach YouTube audience with video ads before/during their video watching
Creative Tips: Hook in first 5 seconds (before skip button) is everything. State the offer/brand in first 3 seconds for skippable ads. For non-skippable (15s), every second counts. Include a clear end card CTA.
Targeting: Custom Intent Audiences (searching for keywords related to your product). Remarketing from YouTube channel and website. Affinity audiences for awareness goals.
Budget: CPV campaigns: pay per view. Budget: $20-50/day for testing. Non-skippable costs more but guarantees full view.
Metrics: CPV (cost per view), view rate (%), conversions from video (use YouTube conversion tracking), view-through conversions
Best For: Brand awareness, product education, consideration-stage buyers, retargeting after blog/organic visits
